payload.description: Learn how to use agentic AI tools (like OpenAI Codex or Claude Cowork) the way you'd delegate to a capable staff member — with planning, clear instructions, and proper review. Based on Devon Coombs' framework for finance and accounting teams.
payload.name: Treat AI Like Staff — A Practical Guide to Using Agentic AI Tools
